instruction: スクリーンショットの確認記録も通信設定の変更も不要。点数はつけなくていいから、自律的に公開までお願いします。
effect: check-design-review.mjs accepts a Design run with no scored review only when that run captured its screens and has no objective failures other than the measured timing overruns that the bound 2026-10-21 screening-priority policy classifies as deferred warnings; those are printed as warnings and strict_result stays failed. No scores are recorded or implied.
revoke: Delete this file to require scored screenshot reviews again.
timing_instruction: 速度の基準超過も保留にして公開してよい
